Options: 
A. P(A, B | C) * P(C | A, B)
B. P(A | B) * P(B | C) * P(C)
C. P(C | A, B) * P(A) * P(B)
D. P(A, B | C) * P(C)
E. P(A | B, C) * P(B) * P(C)
F. P(A | B) * P(B | C) * P(C | A, B)
G. P(A | B, C) * P(B | A, C) * P(C | A, B)
H. P(A, B) * P(B, C) * P(C, A)
I. P(A | B) * P(B | C) * P(C | A)
J. P(A, B, C | D) * P(D)

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
